notes: Consent workflow stories defined across schema, logic, API, testing, and integration layers.

stories.title: Consent Schema and Tier Definition
stories.description: Define data model for two-tier HIPAA consent including Tier 1 (basic interaction) and Tier 2 (identified data storage). Include fields for consent_status, tier_level, timestamp, user identifiers (if applicable), and audit metadata.

stories.title: Consent Evaluation and Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic in ConsentService to evaluate user consent tier and enforce rules for data storage, ensuring de-identification for Tier 1 and allowing identified storage only for Tier 2.

stories.title: Consent API and Tool Integration
stories.description: Expose consent handling through tool_router and application layer, enabling consent capture, updates, and checks during chat flows and lead capture interactions.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Testing Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering consent tier transitions, enforcement of de-identification, and prevention of unauthorized data storage when consent is not granted.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_unanswerable_questions.py; GAP: No dedicated consent test suite exists

stories.title: Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
stories.description: Integrate consent workflow with lead capture and unknown question services to ensure consent is checked before storing any user-identifiable information or conversation summaries.

per_feature.mitigation: Leverage existing ConsentService and enforce strict tier checks without expanding scope.
